collection_item_photos_owner_all.name: collection_item_photos_owner_all
collection_item_photos_owner_all.using:
exists (
        select 1 from "collection_items"
        where "collection_items"."id" = "collection_item_photos"."collection_item_id"
        and "collection_items"."user_id" = (select auth.uid())
      )
collection_item_photos_owner_all.withCheck:
exists (
        select 1 from "collection_items"
        where "collection_items"."id" = "collection_item_photos"."collection_item_id"
        and "collection_items"."user_id" = (select auth.uid())
      )
